mcat_description.short: Office Container is a prefabricated, portable steel workspace unit — typically in 20ft or 40ft configurations — factory-built with insulated walls, electrical fittings, doors, and windows for rapid deployment as a site office or temporary workspace.
mcat_description.long: Office Containers are self-contained, relocatable workspace structures fabricated from mild steel or container-grade steel frames with sandwich panel (PUF/EPS/glass wool) insulation, designed for construction sites, industrial facilities, and infrastructure projects across India. Standard configurations follow 20ft x 8ft x 8.5ft and 40ft x 10ft x 8.5ft dimensions, with interiors pre-fitted with electrical wiring, LED lighting, MCB boards, flooring (vinyl/laminate/plywood), and provision for air conditioning. Units are delivered factory-assembled and can be relocated via crane or forklift using integrated lifting hooks, with no permanent civil foundation required. Customisation options include attached toilets, pantry units, manager cabins, workstations, partition walls, and multi-storey stacking for larger site office complexes.

market_context: Office Containers in India are purpose-built prefabricated steel structures — not repurposed shipping containers — manufactured using mild steel (MS) or galvanized iron (GI) frames with sandwich panel insulation (PUF, EPS, or glass wool), and are distinct from generic portable cabins by their container-format rectangular box construction. Standard commercial sizes in the Indian market are 20ft x 8ft x 8.5ft and 40ft x 10ft x 8.5ft/9.5ft, with custom sizes ranging from 10ft to 60ft length; high-cube variants at 9.6ft height are also available. Structural materials include mild steel, Corten steel, aluminium, Galvalume, and GI sheet; insulation panels are typically 50mm PUF or EPS sandwich panels. Key certifications referenced by Indian manufacturers include ISO 9001:2015 quality systems and ISI-certified steel; some export-grade units carry CSC plate and TPI certification. The dominant buyer is a construction contractor or infrastructure project manager procuring for temporary site office use; secondary buyers include industrial plant operators, mining companies, and rental/leasing firms. Manufacturing hubs are concentrated in NCR (Faridabad, Greater Noida), Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, and Hyderabad. Units are delivered factory-assembled and relocated via crane or forklift using integrated lifting hooks, with no permanent civil foundation required. Rental (per month per unit) is a significant secondary transaction mode alongside outright purchase.
